# Performance comparison

Every figure in the C6 performance contract is currently `UNMEASURED`.

This is deliberate. The contract says not to report a frame rate from an environment that presents too few frames to support the calculation, and this environment presents none: there is no DRM device, so there is no page-flip and no vblank to pace against, and rendering falls to a software rasteriser. A frame time measured here would describe the CPU, and publishing it as a compositor figure would be the most quietly misleading number in the whole programme.

| Gate | Mandatory | Smithay | libmutter |
|---|---|---|---|
| GPU rendering | **yes** | `NOT_AVAILABLE` | `NOT_AVAILABLE` |
| linux-dmabuf | no | `NOT_AVAILABLE` | `NOT_AVAILABLE` |
| frame pacing | no | `NOT_AVAILABLE` | `NOT_AVAILABLE` |
| damage-driven rendering | no | `NOT_RUN` | `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` |
| two-output presentation | **yes** | `NOT_AVAILABLE` | `NOT_AVAILABLE` |
| mixed-DPI scaling | no | `NOT_RUN` | `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` |
| output hotplug | no | `NOT_AVAILABLE` | `NOT_AVAILABLE` |

Recorded reasons:

- compositor/bunny-mutter-v4 has no downstream shell implementation yet, so there is nothing to measure.
- no /dev/dri; OpenGL renderer is llvmpipe (software rasterizer). A software rasteriser cannot qualify GPU rendering.
- no DRM connectors. Nested windows are not outputs presenting frames.
- no DRM device, so no dmabuf import/export path with real format modifiers.
- no KMS page-flip and no vblank, so there is no clock to pace against.
- no outputs exist to add or remove.
- not executed in V4. The V3 prototype is the starting point; no V4 measurement has been made.

## Status

No gate in this matrix has been measured. Nothing here supports a framework selection, and nothing here may be cited as qualification evidence.
